Introducing Lilbish
The musical alter ego of comedian, clown & creator - Abish Mathew.
A collision of Rap, Rock, Hip-Hop, and EDM.
Social commentary meets unadulterated comedy.
"Lungs On Fire" by Lilbish is a satirical anthem about the harsh realities of urban pollution, crumbling city infrastructure & civic frustration.
Redeveloping our environmental nightmare, into an energetic musical Rap-Rock track!
Which will make you laugh and cough at the same time.
